curated.tagline: Open-source multi-model computer-use agent with disposable sandboxes
curated.outcome: An open-source computer-use agent that routes across models and runs each task in a disposable sandbox.
curated.description: Open-source equivalent of a cloud computer-use agent: multi-model routing, disposable sandboxed execution, and hybrid local/cloud placement.
curated.architecture: Task intake → model routing → disposable sandbox → execution → result capture

release.transcript: A narrated walkthrough of Open Computer: a goal becomes a plan of steps, each routed to a fitting model and run in its own sandbox, with an approval gate for sensitive steps and a cost cap per run. It says plainly that a full run from goal to artifact is not proven yet.

showcaseCard.thumbnailAlt: Frame from the Open Computer explainer: where it is going, today versus the planned v1 on Cloudflare.

started.summary: First commit: a one-command, cost-capped agent runner on the owner's own machines.

done: Conformance harness and fs-protocol spec v0.1
Execplane with a live CubeSandbox adapter
